name: Corrupting Touch
body:
School evocation [corruption]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2, magus 2, witch 2, antipaladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial, Will (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

One creature touched is wracked with immense pain as their body is surrounded by corrupted energies which seek to tear the target to pieces from the inside out. This deals 1d6 points of corruption damage per caster level (maximum of 10d6 damage) and the target must make a fortitude save to halve damage. The user of this spell must make a Will Save equal to the damage dealt or turn Chaotic Evil for 2 rounds, if they already aren’t already Chaotic Evil.
